in_marathi.name: Janardhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Janardhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Janardhan is a popular Hindu name, derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Lord of the World'. In Hindu mythology, Janardhan is a form of Lord Vishnu, who is revered as the sustainer and protector of the universe. The name evokes a sense of strength, power, and divine presence.
